tasks.corrected_reference_answer: RequestsMock defaults assert_all_requests_are_fired to True (responses/__init__.py:529-538), while module default mock explicitly sets False (responses/__init__.py:843). The decorator uses get_wrapped, whose generated body enters with responses, so it shares the same stop/reset lifecycle as context-manager usage (responses/__init__.py:152-155,692-703). stop checks uncalled registrations when assertions are enabled and no active exception suppresses them (responses/__init__.py:808-822). The source establishes different configuration defaults, not the asserted necessity to avoid cross-test leakage.
